title: English Practice Quiz 0893
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Quality assurance focuses on ___.
questions.explanation: preventing defects through reliable processes is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A quality check compares output against ___.
questions.explanation: defined requirements or standards is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A non-conformance is ___.
options: a failure to meet a specified requirement
questions.explanation: a failure to meet a specified requirement is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Corrective action is intended to ___.
options: address the cause of an identified problem
questions.explanation: address the cause of an identified problem is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A sample inspection examines ___.
options: a selected portion of a larger batch
questions.explanation: a selected portion of a larger batch is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Why calibrate measuring equipment?
questions.explanation: To maintain reliable measurement accuracy is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A quality trend report can identify ___.
options: repeated patterns or changes in defects
questions.explanation: repeated patterns or changes in defects is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Corrective action should be checked to confirm ___.
options: it has addressed the issue effectively
questions.explanation: it has addressed the issue effectively is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A quality checklist helps inspectors ___.
questions.explanation: apply consistent checks is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Continuous improvement means ___.
questions.explanation: regularly reviewing and improving processes is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
